name: mnote_list_notes
description: List all the account's notes (flat — there are no folders). Returns summaries (no bodies): id, title, slug (used to address a note), is_favorite, created_at, updated_at, last_accessed_at, and `categories` (the note's color-coded tags: id, name, color). Optional `sort` orders newest-first by `updated` (last edited, default) or `accessed` (last opened). Optional `category` (a category id) returns only notes tagged with it. Use a note's `slug` before mnote_get_note / mnote_update_note / mnote_delete_note — and as the target when you write a `[[slug]]` link into another note's body. This is the lookup table for linking: call it before writing a note that should reference existing ones.

sort.description: Order newest-first by last edited (updated) or last opened (accessed). Default updated.

category.description: Optional category id to filter by (from mnote_list_categories).
